Thus algorithm:

def postorder(pre):
    def helper(l, r):
        if l > r:
            return
        root = pre[l]
        # find first index > root
        i = l+1
        while i <= r and pre[i] < root:
            i += 1
        # left part: l+1 .. i-1
        helper(l+1, i-1)
        # right part: i .. r
        helper(i, r)
        result.append(root)

But careful: For duplicates, if there is equal value to root, they will be in right part (since condition is < root). So equal values are not included in left, they go to right. That's fine.
